chunking: fixed_size (character windows within a page; no boundary snapping)
metadata: document_id, source, page, printed_page, chapter, chapter_title, section, subsection
vectorizer: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 via fastembed ONNX (384-d; cosine; pgvector exact)
hypothesis: Baseline. Fixed windows will cut sentences and evidence quotes, so Evidence Hit@3 should be lower than B and coherence the lowest.
notes: 436 chunks; embed 36.6 s; coherence 0.7/2; grounding 1.83/2 (overlapping windows put both halves of split evidence in top-3); 7 of its 8 Hit@3 misses (dev+test) flagged evidence_split_suspected. Hypothesis supported for Hit@3 and coherence.

chunking: by_paragraph (whole paragraphs grouped up to max; new chunk at every heading; long paragraphs split at sentence ends)
hypothesis: Paragraph-aligned chunks keep evidence and its conditions together: higher coherence and Evidence Hit@3 than A with fewer chunks. Only chunking changes vs A.
notes: 337 chunks; embed 44.9 s; coherence 1.6/2; grounding 1.83/2. Test miss t05: court quote split from its lead-in sentence. Hypothesis supported.

chunking: same as B (reuses B index and vectors)
filter: chapter = user-supplied scope, applied only to the 6 questions that carry a filter

notes: Selected by pre-registered rule (tie on dev Hit@3, wins dev Hit@1). Filter fixed 3 dev rank-2 cases (q11, q12, q14) to rank 1; filter compliance 4/4 dev, 2/2 test vs 0/4, 0/2 for B. Test identical to B except filtered t01/t02 (already rank 1 in B).
